subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should OpenClaw accept MiniMax M3 native video as provider-owned media-understanding work only, also extend core/session VideoContent or readVideo contracts, or defer it to the broader direct-video feature?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the correct boundary crosses provider API policy, raw-video security, session/tool content contracts, and prompt semantics.

options.title: Split and keep tracking
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for small maintainer-reviewed slices that separate MiniMax provider support from any core VideoContent/readVideo API decision.

options.title: Fold into generic video
options.body: Treat the MiniMax hint as evidence for the broader direct-video issue and close only after the generic plan explicitly preserves the MiniMax-specific requirement.

options.title: Defer native video
options.body: Do not accept raw native video egress yet and document that MiniMax M3 video remains unsupported until security and retention policy are settled.

recommendation.title: Split and keep tracking
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for small maintainer-reviewed slices that separate MiniMax provider support from any core VideoContent/readVideo API decision.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest MiniMax provider history and is the best available routing owner for the provider/core boundary decision.
